Name: Target stock
Description: The stock to reach by the target day.

Name: Days left
Description: Days until the target day, counting today (at least 1).

Name: Gap per day
Equation: (Target stock - Stock optimal plan) / Days left
Description: An even share of what is missing, per day left.

Name: Required MB
Equation: MAX(0, Consumption forecast + Gap per day)
Description: What must arrive today: the burn plus the gap share, never below zero.

Name: Trucks needed
Description: Whole trucks for the required MB.

Name: Trucks planned
Equation: Ready * MIN(Trucks needed, Max trucks per day)
Description: Trucks of the optimal plan: limited by what the skids can unload.

Name: Closing stock optimal
Equation: Stock optimal plan + Delivery optimal plan - Burn optimal plan
Description: Stock at the end of the day, optimal plan.

Name: Closing stock current
Equation: Stock current plan + Delivery current plan - Burn current plan
Description: Stock at the end of the day, current plan.

Name: Closing fill optimal
Description: Fill level at the end of the day, optimal plan.

Name: Closing fill current
Description: Fill level at the end of the day, current plan.

Name: Shortage vs target
Equation: Ready * MAX(0, Target stock - Closing stock current)
Description: How far the current plan leaves the tank below target.

Name: Below minimum
Description: 1 when the current plan leaves the tank below its minimum level.

Name: Region stock optimal
Description: Stock of the region's tanks, optimal plan.

Name: Region stock current
Description: Stock of the region's tanks, current plan.

Name: Region capacity
Description: Capacity of the region's tanks.

Name: Region trucks optimal
Description: Trucks per day the region's tanks need, optimal plan.

Name: Region trucks current
Description: Trucks per day in the current plan for the region.

Name: Region shortage
Description: Shortage against target in the region, current plan.

Name: Region fill optimal
Description: Region fill level, optimal plan.

Name: Region fill current
Description: Region fill level, current plan.

Name: Network stock optimal
Description: All tanks together, optimal plan.

Name: Network stock current
Description: All tanks together, current plan.

Name: Network capacity
Description: All tank capacity.

Name: Network trucks optimal
Description: Trucks per day, all tanks, optimal plan.

Name: Network trucks current
Description: Trucks per day, all tanks, current plan.

Name: Network shortage
Description: Shortage against target, all tanks, current plan.

Name: Network fill optimal
Description: Fill level of the whole network, optimal plan.

Name: Network fill current
Description: Fill level of the whole network, current plan.
